# ibh

> ibh is an application-agnostic, in-browser agent harness. Drop it into any
> website: signed-in users get a chat panel that can call the site's API with
> their existing session, operate the page's DOM, and navigate — gated by an
> explicit capability manifest the site authors and the runtime enforces
> (validation → consent tiers → rate limits → budgets → execution → audit log).
> Framework components for React, Vue, Angular, Svelte and Solid ship as npm
> packages, with voice input (speech-to-text via OpenRouter STT models) built
> in; LLM calls run through a thin proxy on the integrator's backend so no key
> ever ships to the browser.

## Docs

- [Integration guide](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/docs/integration-guide.md): install, manifest authoring, auth adapters, LLM access modes (proxy vs BYO user key), theming, opt-in session persistence, headless consent, framework notes
- [Capability manifest spec](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/docs/manifest-spec.md): the hard contract — api/dom/nav capabilities, consent tiers, schemas, policies, fail-closed validation rules
- [Security model](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/docs/security-model.md): enforcement stack, consent tiers, prompt-injection hardening, honest limits (best-effort client-side; server-side authorization is the real boundary)
- [Non-goals](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/docs/non-goals.md): no undo (ever), no library consent defaults, no raw model network access
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the same integration playbook, written for AI coding agents

## Proxy reference implementations (LLM access without key leakage)

Integrators run two proxy routes on their backend (`{llm.baseUrl}/chat/completions`
and `/audio/transcriptions`): authenticate with the existing session, enforce the
model allowlist server-side, forward to OpenRouter with the server-side key, strip
user cookies. The node and Rocket references also surface OpenRouter's real
per-request cost (`usage.cost`) to the integrator — an `ibh.usage {...}` log line
attributed to the session user plus `X-Ibh-*` response headers — so an integrator
can meter what each user spends and charge them however they like. That is a
business-logic-proxy concern only (config-only nginx/Apache cannot read response
bodies; the browser never needs cost). References to translate or deploy:

- [Proxy overview + contract](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/proxy/README.md): the ~40-line contract, Next.js and Cloudflare snippets
- [Pure node server](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/proxy/server.js): zero dependencies
- [Cloudflare Worker](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/proxy/cloudflare/README.md): deployable, tested, full docs (JWT-HS256 or remote session verify)
- [nginx config](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/proxy/nginx.conf.example): config-only via auth_request; one-hardcoded-model tradeoff
- [Apache config](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/proxy/apache.conf.example): config-only via mod_auth_openidc / mod_authnz_fcgi
- [Rust / Rocket server](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/proxy/rocket/README.md): compiled binary, exact-pinned deps

## Examples

- [gametorch-demo](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/gametorch-demo/): the reference integration (mock API, dashboard, editor, auto sign-in)
- [plain-html](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/plain-html/): minimal integration on a static page
- [React / Next.js guide](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/react-next/README.md)
- [Vue / Nuxt guide](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/vue/README.md)
- [Angular guide](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/angular/README.md)
- [Svelte / SvelteKit guide](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/svelte/README.md)
- [Solid / SolidStart guide](https://github.com/gametorch/ibh/blob/main/examples/solid/README.md)

## Packages (npm, official gametorch account)

- [`@gametorch/ibh`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gametorch/ibh): self-contained umbrella — `init()`, IIFE + ESM bundle
- [`@gametorch/ibh-react`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gametorch/ibh-react): drop-in `<IbhChat />`
- [`@gametorch/ibh-vue`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gametorch/ibh-vue): drop-in `<IbhChat>`
- [`@gametorch/ibh-angular`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gametorch/ibh-angular): `<ibh-chat>` standalone directive
- [`@gametorch/ibh-svelte`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gametorch/ibh-svelte): `<IbhChat>` + `use:ibhChat` action
- [`@gametorch/ibh-solid`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gametorch/ibh-solid): `<IbhChat>` + `use:ibhChat` directive
